sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, p.captured_at::text AS t, p.market_ticker AS b, coalesce(p.side,'-') AS c, p.quantity::text AS d, coalesce(p.avg_price::text,'-') AS e, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') AS f, coalesce(p.market_exposure::text,'-') AS h FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18%' ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 6) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, o.created_at::text, o.market_ticker, coalesce(o.strategy,'-'), coalesce(o.side,'-'), o.limit_price::text, coalesce(o.status,'-'), coalesce(o.event_ticker,'-') FROM live_orders o WHERE o.event_ticker = 'KXRT-RES' OR o.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES%' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 10) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, p2.captured_at::text, p2.market_ticker, coalesce(p2.side,'-'), p2.quantity::text, coalesce(p2.avg_price::text,'-'), coalesce(p2.realized_pnl::text,'-'), coalesce(p2.market_exposure::text,'-') FROM positions p2 WHERE p2.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES-9%' AND p2.captured_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p2.captured_at DESC LIMIT 8)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
